primaryHubAnswerBefore.question: Which gap affects the most frameworks?
primaryHubAnswerBefore.executiveAnswer: The highest-impact gap is missing current assessment evidence for several critical suppliers. A supplier-assurance policy exists, but it is being counted separately in each framework and is not backed by current assessments.

sourcedFacts.text: The supplier assurance policy is current (version 3.0).
Internal audit findings record that current critical-supplier assessments are missing.
The same control supports obligations in ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR and NCA ECC.

primaryHubAnswerBefore.interpretation: Because one evidence gap sits under four international frameworks, closing it improves coverage and connected risk more than treating each framework as a separate project.
primaryHubAnswerBefore.recommendedAction: Upload current critical-supplier assessments and approve the suggested mappings before the review.
primaryHubAnswerBefore.freshness: Policy current; assessments missing; 2023 pack expired
primaryHubAnswerBefore.expectedImpact: Coverage rises across the four frameworks; supplier-assurance moves from partial to assured; third-party and regulatory exposure reduce; Board Summary can cite current assessments.
